skill.name: data-analyst
skill.description: Provides guidance for SQL querying, pandas analysis, statistical methods, data cleaning, and interpretation of dataset patterns.
skill.summary: Helps users explore data, write SQL, analyze with pandas, and explain statistical findings.
skill.author: shubhamsaboo

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, network access, or filesystem abuse.

content.user_title: Analyze Data with SQL and pandas
content.value_statement: Data work often needs clear queries, repeatable transformations, and careful interpretation. This skill guides SQL, pandas, statistics, and data cleaning workflows.
actual_capabilities: Drafts SQL queries using joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and subqueries.
Explains pandas transformations for grouping, filtering, pivoting, time series work, and missing data.
Supports descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, and basic predictive modeling.
Helps plan data cleaning, preparation, and transformation steps before analysis.
Adds comments, example results, performance notes, and interpretation guidance to analysis outputs.
limitations: Does not connect to databases or files by itself.
Needs users to provide schemas, sample data, or column definitions for precise results.
Cannot verify query performance without the target database engine and data distribution.
Provides analytical guidance, not regulated financial, medical, or legal advice.

use_cases.title: Build Reporting Queries
use_cases.description: Create SQL queries for metrics, joins, aggregations, and window functions across business tables.

use_cases.title: Clean Research Data
use_cases.description: Plan pandas steps for missing values, reshaping, time series preparation, and exploratory summaries.

use_cases.title: Review Product Metrics
use_cases.description: Interpret trends, correlations, and test results before sharing decisions with stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dataset description and suggest SQL or pandas steps for profiling columns, missing values, and useful summaries: [dataset details].

prompt_templates.title: Write a Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a SQL query for this schema and question. Include joins, filters, aggregations, and comments: [schema and business question].

prompt_templates.title: Design an Analysis Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an analysis plan for this hypothesis. Include cleaning steps, statistical tests, assumptions to check, and interpretation guidance: [hypothesis and data].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SQL or pandas workflow for correctness, performance risks, and clearer outputs. Recommend improvements with reasoning: [workflow details].

output_examples.input: A sales table has order dates, regions, revenue, and customer identifiers. Find monthly revenue trends.
output: Suggested monthly aggregation by order month and region.
Recommended checks for missing dates, duplicated orders, and uneven regional coverage.
Interpretation notes comparing growth rates and seasonal changes.

output_examples.input: A user has pandas data with missing values and product categories. Prepare it for analysis.
output: Profile missingness by column before removing records.
Standardize category labels and document any recoding decisions.
Use grouped summaries to confirm the cleaned data matches expectations.

output_examples.input: A team wants to compare conversion rates before and after a product change.
output: Suggested a hypothesis test for two proportions.
Listed assumptions, sample size checks, and possible confounding factors.
Explained how to report statistical and practical significance.

best_practices: Share schemas, column meanings, and sample rows before requesting queries or transformations.
Ask for assumptions and interpretation, not only query or pandas syntax.
Validate results with row counts, missing value checks, and known business totals.
anti_patterns: Do not request production-ready conclusions from undocumented or incomplete data.
Do not skip validation checks after cleaning, joining, or reshaping data.
Do not treat correlation, model output, or test results as causation without support.

faq.question: Can this skill write SQL queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft queries using joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, filters, and optimization notes.

faq.question: Can it help with pandas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide grouping, filtering, pivoting, time series analysis, and missing data handling.

faq.question: Does it execute database queries?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and code suggestions, but execution depends on the connected environment.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide schemas, column meanings, sample rows, data size, desired metrics, and the database or pandas context.

faq.question: Can it perform statistical analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, and basic predictive modeling guidance.

faq.question: Is it safe to publish?
faq.answer: The reviewed skill is prompt-only, with no static or semantic security findings.
